strategies.overview: Galarian Articuno's main draw is its high Special Attack and good matchup into threats like Flamigo, Toxicroak, and Amoonguss. Its ability, Competitive, also makes it very attractive, since stat-dropping moves and abilities like Brambleghast's Strength Sap as well as Paldean Tauros-W's and Incineroar's Intimidate are commonplace. Additionally, Galarian Articuno is one of the few viable Future Sight users, combining very well with NU's many Fighting-type wallbreakers like Heracross, Flamigo, Infernape, and Paldean Tauros-W. However, Steel- and Dark-types like Registeel, Bronzong, and Alolan Muk being everywhere holds it back. Not only that, but Galarian Articuno is also forced to compete with Oricorio-P and -F. Unlike Galarian Articuno, these Oricorio formes have access to Quiver Dance and Taunt as well as Revelation Dance, which is useful before Terastallization unlike the Tera Blast that Galarian Articuno is forced to use. Galarian Articuno's Speed and defensive profile can be disappointing at times as well, since Pokemon such as Staraptor, Flygon, and the Paldean Tauros formes can easily outpace it whereas Basculegion-M's Aqua Jet, Decidueye's Shadow Sneak, and Toxicroak's Sucker Punch all threaten to deal great damage to it.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Shadow Ball can be run on Calm Mind sets to hit Bronzong, but it's nearly useless outside of that matchup.

Checks and Counters

Steel-types: Bronzong, Registeel, Copperajah, Klefki, and Duraludon can all check Galarian Articuno. Additionally, they can use it to set up their entry hazards; Bronzong, Registeel, and Duraludon can boost their stats; and Klefki as well as Duraludon can paralyze it. However, Registeel, Copperajah, and Duraludon have to be cautious of Tera Blast Fighting.

Dark-types: Incineroar and Alolan Muk can take Galarian Articuno's Psychic-type STAB moves, but the former needs to worry about its Intimidate activating Competitive and, consequently, boosting Hurricane. Additionally, while Overqwil and Dragon Dance Scrafty don't take Hurricane too well, they can outspeed and threaten Galarian Articuno with Throat Chop and Knock Off.

Electric-types: While Kilowattrel, Raikou, and Toxtricity don't switch into Galarian Articuno's Psychic-type STAB attacks too well, the former two outspeed it, and they all threaten it with huge damage.

movesets.name: Calm Mind
movesets.description:
Set Details

On more balanced teams, Galarian Articuno prefers a moveset of Calm Mind / Recover / Hurricane or Air Slash / Psyshock. However, on more offensive or hyper offense builds, it can opt for other moves like Agility, Tera Blast, and Stored Power. Recover allows Galarian Articuno to repeatedly set up throughout the course of a match, letting it wear down walls like Bronzong. Hurricane hits Dark-types like Wo-Chien and Scrafty, and it's especially strong against Incineroar and Overqwil due to Intimidate activating Galarian Articuno's Competitive. Alternatively, Air Slash can be run for its higher accuracy. Psyshock is a decently powered Psychic-type STAB move with no drawback, and it helps to win Calm Mind wars versus Sylveon, Scream Tail, and opposing Galarian Articuno, while also forcing Chansey to Tera Dark. Stored Power aims to capitalize on Agility compounding with Calm Mind boosts. Psychic Noise can be used on balanced builds so that Galarian Articuno aids its team in breaking through walls like Vaporeon and Bellibolt, denying them from healing, though it can be weak at times. Tera Blast Fairy lets Galarian Articuno hit Dark-types like Scrafty more reliably than Hurricane, though many of them like Incineroar and Overqwil are still hit neutrally by it. However, in general, Tera Fairy offers Galarian Articuno a solid defensive typing that helps it against most of the tier's threats like Heracross, Flygon, and Incineroar. On the other hand, Tera Ground mainly bolsters Galarian Articuno's offensive capability, providing super-effective coverage on Incineroar, Copperajah, and Duraludon. Heavy-Duty Boots allows Galarian Articuno to constantly come in on and threaten Pokemon like Flamigo, Calm Mind Sylveon, and Altaria regardless of entry hazards. Alternatively, Galarian Articuno can go for Grassy Seed on Grassy Terrain teams to ease setup opportunities. Weakness Policy can also be run to boost Stored Power's Base Power quickly. Tera Steel offers Galarian Articuno an incredible defensive typing, which helps with taking powerful attacks like Alolan Ninetales's Blizzard, Duraludon's Draco Meteor, and Flygon's Dragon-type STAB attacks.

Hyper offense teams can best support Weakness Policy Galarian Articuno with Cinccino, especially lead sets of Cinccino to ensure entry hazards are removed, and Aurora Veil from Alolan Ninetales, which lets Galarian Articuno better withstand super effective attacks to activate its Weakness Policy. In return, Galarian Articuno's Competitive deters Defog, ensuring Aurora Veil stays up. On these teams, Galarian Articuno appreciates teammates like Porygon-Z, Toxtricity, Flygon, and Paldean Tauros formes to weaken or outright KO Steel-types like Bronzong, Registeel, and Duraludon for it. Similarly, more balanced teams can take advantage of partners like Chandelure, Heracross, and Flygon for their ability to threaten these Steel-types. For Grassy Seed Galarian Articuno sets, Thwackey is a vital teammate to set Grassy Terrain. Additionally, other Terrain sweepers that can take advantage of Grassy Terrain like Grafaiai, Diancie, Oricorio-F, and Hitmonlee synergize well, as the first two can overwhelm Steel-types alongside Galarian Articuno, while the latter two can beat them outright. Dark-types such as Incineroar, Alolan Muk, and Scrafty can be problematic for Galarian Articuno to deal with, making Pokemon like Paldean Tauros-W, Heracross, and Sylveon good partners. On top of that, these Pokemon can also act as good Knock Off switch-ins. In return, Galarian Articuno handles pesky Poison-types like Amoonguss and Galarian Slowbro for them.

movesets.name: Future Sight Pivot
movesets.description:
Set Details

Tera Fairy gifts Galarian Articuno an amazing defensive profile, letting it take on Scrafty, Flygon, and, in a pinch, Toxicroak. Alternatively, Tera Steel lets Galarian Articuno take on powerful special wallbreakers like Sylveon, Porygon-Z, and Munkidori. Tera Ground lets Galarian Articuno become immune to Kilowattrel's Electric-type attacks and resist Diancie's Rock-type STAB moves.

Future Sight Galarian Articuno is best paired alongside wallbreakers like Paldean Tauros-W, Infernape, Heracross, and Flygon, since they can capitalize on it drawing in and pivoting on Steel- and Dark-types as well as specially defensive blanket checks like Incineroar, Bronzong, Registeel, and Porygon2 with its U-turn. On top of that, Galarian Articuno's Future Sight dissuades Poison-types like Galarian Slowbro and Amoonguss from switching in. Similarly, Fairy-type wallbreakers like Alolan Ninetales, Sylveon, and Diancie can take advantage of Galarian Articuno drawing in and pivoting on Dark-types with its U-turn and discouraging Poison-types from switching in with its Future Sight. Additionally, together they can work to wear down shared Steel-type checks. Knock Off switch-ins are vital for Galarian Articuno, since it is both weak to the move and vulnerable to Stealth Rock. Because of this, Pokemon like Diancie, Paldean Tauros-W, and Overqwil make for good teammates. Bulky Psychic-types like Galarian Slowbro, Uxie, and Scream Tail can be difficult for Galarian Articuno and, at times, the wallbreakers it's paired with to break through, so Galarian Articuno pairs well with Pokemon such as Incineroar, Decidueye, and specially oriented Substitute Basculegion-M.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 7 onwards

Price Range: 3-5 Points

Overview: Galarian Articuno is a low-cost immunity to Ground, pivot, and special wallbreaker. Despite its relative lack of coverage, it can switch in on resisted moves, fire off a Future Sight, and then escape with U-turn to bring in a Pokemon that can take advantage of foes that resist Psychic. Opponents also need to beware of a potential late-game sweep from this masked menace. Unfortunately, Galarian Articuno suffers from some fatal flaws, including its middling speed for an offensive Pokemon, lack of coverage, and weaknesses to common offensive types like Dark and Ice. Additionally, its weakness to Rock can clip this bird's wings.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Offensive Pivot: U-turn makes Galarian Articuno a viable offensive pivot that is able to switch in and out while using Future Sight to help sweepers break through walls or position teammates that check Steel- and Dark-types to take advantage of those Pokemon. Competitive lets it switch in to punish Defog and other stat reduction moves.

Setup Sweeper: Galarian Articuno can use Calm Mind alongside its high Special Attack to become an effective late-game setup sweeper. It can also boost its Speed with Agility and gain additional boosts via Weakness Policy, letting it become an effective Stored Power sweeper.

Wallbreaker: Choice Specs can turn Galarian Articuno into a powerful wallbreaker than can punch holes in teams with its STAB moves or set up teammates with a powerful Future Sight. Its lack of coverage can make these sets somewhat harder to position and make good use of.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Future Sight, Freezing Glare, Hurricane, Psychic, Psyshock, Psychic Noise, Stored Power

Setup Moves: Agility, Calm Mind

Utility Moves: U-turn, Recover, Light Screen, Reflect, Hypnosis, Trick

Coverage: Shadow Ball, Hyper Voice, Ancient Power, Tera Blast

Niche Moves

Endure: Endure can be used with Weakness Policy to ensure Galarian Articuno survives an attack to take advantage of the Special Attack boost.

Tailwind: In late-game scenarios, Tailwind can be set to support Galarian Articuno's teammates, which it can reliably pivot to with U-turn.

Common Items

Heavy-Duty Boots: Being a pivot that is weak to Stealth Rock means Galarian Articuno is contractually obligated to lace up the timbs every week.

Choice Specs: Wallbreaking sets can use Choice Specs to turn Galarian Articuno into a powerful wallbreaker that can punch holes in most Pokemon or shut down a utility Pokemon with Trick.

Choice Scarf: Galarian Articuno is outsped by most offensive threats, making Choice Scarf a decent option for speed control and revenge killing. It can also shut down utility Pokemon by giving them the Choice Scarf via Trick.

Niche Items

Weakness Policy: The favored item of Stored Power sweepers, Weakness Policy lets Galarian Articuno bypass the need to use Calm Mind and immediately start sweeping, especially when combined with Agility.

Light Clay: Galarian Articuno can be a passable dual screens setter, and Light Clay ensures they last long enough to protect your sweepers.

Tera

Galarian Articuno can be a good secondary Tera Captain to pair with one that is higher priced. It typically isn't worth it otherwise, as higher-cost Captains have a lot more to offer both offensively and defensively. If Galarian Articuno is your choice for a Tera Captain, then Tera Blast becomes a strong option on it due to its lack of coverage. Offensive Tera types like Tera Fighting, Fairy, and Ground help it break through Steel- and Dark-type Pokemon, while defensively, Tera Steel can let it survive attacks it would otherwise faint to and get one more crucial turn to set up.

Draft Strategy

Galarian Articuno is a great choice for a cheap pivot and immunity to Ground. It doesn't have the utility of Pokemon like Uxie and Azelf, but it forces opponents to always keep its strong Special Attack and late-game sweeping capabilities in mind. However, due to its lack of coverage and utility, it's not a Pokemon you want to be building your draft around; rather, it's a final piece to fill any holes left over.

Entry Hazard Removal: Being forced to run Heavy-Duty Boots severely limits Galarian Articuno's options and forces it into an offensive pivot role, and having it removed from Knock Off can severely limit the amount of opportunities it has to switch in. Pokemon like Iron Treads, Terapagos, and Great Tusk can keep the field clear for it to do its job.

Knock Off Absorber: Galarian Articuno is both weak to Knock Off and Stealth Rock, meaning that if its Heavy-Duty Boots get removed, it has almost no more chances to switch in. Pokemon like Gliscor, Ogerpon-W, and Ting-Lu that can absorb Knock Off are excellent pairings with it.

Steel- / Psychic- / Dark-type Checks: Pokemon that can take advantage of Future Sight luring in foes that resist it excel when paired with Galarian Articuno. It can pivot to these Pokemon with U-turn and force opponents into either taking a huge chunk of damage on one of their Pokemon from Future Sight or having a Pokemon that resists it broken by a wallbreaker that switches in. Scizor, Urshifu-S, and Darkrai are excellent wallbreakers to pair with Galarian Articuno.

Entry Hazard Setters: Entry hazards can chip down opposing Pokemon that check Galarian Articuno, and as an added bonus, any foes attempting to use Defog to clear hazards run right into Competitive, giving it a large Special Attack boost. Glimmora, Clodsire, and Garchomp are excellent pairings with Galarian Articuno.

Checks and Counters

Bulky Steel- and Dark-types: Galarian Articuno is walled by most Steel- and Dark-types due to its lack of coverage moves. Anything from Heatran to Revavroom to Ting-Lu can switch in and easily take most attacks from it.

Priority: Galarian Articuno can be easily revenge killed by most strong priority moves, and it is weak to common ones like Sucker Punch. Kingambit and Lycanroc-D can freeze any sweep attempt from it and discourage it from using U-turn to switch out.

Faster Pokemon: Galarian Articuno is on the slower side of offensive Pokemon and is easily outsped by Pokemon like Meowscarada, Chi-Yu, and Greninja that can typically OHKO it with any Dark-type move.
